name: beautyflow-app
description: Monorepo do BeautyFlow App (frontend Next.js + backend NestJS + tipos compartilhados). Não inclui os workflows n8n em n8n/, que permanecem fora deste workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@beautyflow/frontend" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@beautyflow/backend"
